units.source_text: 第二年的秋天，信子陪出差东京的丈夫，一起回到了阔别已久的故乡。

en.t: In the autumn of the following year, Nobuko accompanied her husband on his business trip to Tokyo, and together they returned to the hometown she had been away from for so long.

units.source_text: 丈夫要在短暂的出差期间完成很多工作，因此只匆忙带着信子看望了一下母亲，就再也没时间陪她外出。

en.t: Her husband had a great deal of work to finish during the brief business trip, so after hurriedly taking Nobuko to see his mother, he had no more time to go out with her.

units.source_text: 信子去郊外看望妹妹照子的时候，也是一个人乘车到电车终点站新开发区站，然后坐人力车去的。

en.t: When Nobuko went to the suburbs to visit her younger sister Teruko, she also went alone, taking the train to the terminal stop, New Development District Station, and then continuing by rickshaw.
